description: Submit a demand evidence record: a durable research artifact giving demand signals provenance — a structured claim about a market condition (e.g. "BSR top-100 spike driven by TikTok review cycle"), sourced from an external reference (URL + excerpt), scoped to one item (by SKU), a tag cohort, or a category. Each evidence record carries a review-by deadline so stale research can't silently persist. The owning client is derived from the target — never supplied. Evidence records give demand signals provenance: a signal can reference the evidence that justifies it via evidenceId.

categoryId.description: The targeted category id (GUID; required for Category scope).

claim.description: One structured sentence describing the market claim (required, max 500 chars).

evidenceScope.description: Evidence scope: Item, Tag, or Category.

excerpt.description: Bounded excerpt from the source supporting the claim (max 2000 chars).

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

itemSku.description: The targeted item's SKU (required for Item scope).

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview (resolved target + claim summary) plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is created until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

retrievedAt.description: When the source material was retrieved (ISO 8601 date).

reviewBy.description: When this evidence must be reviewed for staleness (required; ISO 8601 date).

sourceName.description: Human-readable name of the research source (e.g. "Google Trends", "Industry Report").

sourceUrl.description: URL pointing to the source material.

submittedBy.description: Optional label for the submitting specialist/assistant.

tag.description: The targeted tag, matched against items' tags (required for Tag scope).
